summary: Completed full backend (17/17 pytest) and frontend e2e testing for ChatHel. All critical flows (guest login, public/private/reception/AI chat, area booking, profile, admin events/areas, force checkout, session invalidation) work. AI integration with GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM key returned real Italian responses (e.g., 'La piscina è aperta tutti i giorni dalle 8:00 alle 22:00').

issues: Active bottom-nav button (yellow Home) overlaps and partially hides the 'Prenota' CTA on bookable area cards in mobile-like widths; consider extra bottom padding on scrollable content

action_items: Optional: increase bottom padding in GuestApp content area so the fixed bottom nav doesn't overlap area-card 'Prenota' buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan for forward compatibility
reception threads aggregation uses sender_role 'reception' literal — already consistent; ok
AI fallback returns error message body to client but always 200; acceptable for UX, but consider logging error class for ops
/api/guests excludes session_token but list includes self — frontend must filter; consider filtering server-side
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds hotel + 4 areas + 3 events on startup. Tests create TEST_-prefixed transient guests/events/areas (events/areas cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, messaging (public/private/reception/AI), bookings, admin CRUD, checkout. Frontend uses data-testids as documented. AI endpoint /api/messages with channel='ai' returns the user message immediately and stores AI reply asynchronously (still inside same request handler) — GET /api/messages/ai retrieves both within ~3-5s. Admin reception threads endpoint returns by guest_id; admin UI shows nicknames.
